# lol.trq.orpheus

> A general-purpose Java 17 music library: what is playing, playback controls, cover colours and synced lyrics, from
> Windows media sessions, Linux MPRIS, macOS Now Playing (experimental) and data pushed in by the program. No
> dependencies, no network, MIT.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): requirements, artifacts, usage, privacy, limitations
- [Platforms](docs/platforms.md): what each system provides, native loading, transforming the jars, compatibility
- [Harness](docs/harness.md): the live checks and how to run them
- [Benchmarks](BENCHMARKS.md): JMH numbers and measured targets
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): mental model, patterns that matter, traps
- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md): release notes
- [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md): commit and test conventions

## Core source

- [Orpheus](core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/Orpheus.java): entry point, builder, threads, command routing
- [Engine](core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/internal/Engine.java): selection, merging, position anchoring, events
- [Playback](core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/Playback.java), [Track](core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/Track.java), [Timeline](core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/Timeline.java), [Snapshot](core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/Snapshot.java): the immutable model
- [Controls](core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/Controls.java): commands with typed results
- [AppRules](core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/AppRules.java): which applications are visible
- [Source](core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/source/Source.java), [SessionUpdate](core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/source/SessionUpdate.java), [Transport](core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/source/Transport.java): what a source implements
- [PushSource](core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/source/PushSource.java): a source fed by the program
- [Lrc](core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/lyrics/Lrc.java), [Lyrics](core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/lyrics/Lyrics.java), [LyricsMatcher](core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/lyrics/LyricsMatcher.java), [LocalLyrics](core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/lyrics/LocalLyrics.java), [AudioTags](core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/lyrics/AudioTags.java): lyrics
- [CoverDecoder](core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/cover/CoverDecoder.java), [Palette](core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/cover/Palette.java), [CoverCache](core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/cover/CoverCache.java): covers
- [NativeFiles](core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/internal/NativeFiles.java): verified extraction of bundled native files

## Platform source

- [WindowsSessions](windows/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/windows/WindowsSessions.java), [Bridge](windows/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/windows/Bridge.java), [Blob](windows/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/windows/Blob.java): Windows, Java side
- [sessions.rs](native/orpheus-windows/src/sessions.rs), [jni.rs](native/orpheus-windows/src/jni.rs), [wire.rs](native/orpheus-windows/src/wire.rs): Windows, native side
- [MprisSource](linux/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/linux/MprisSource.java), [Bus](linux/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/linux/dbus/Bus.java), [Wire](linux/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/linux/dbus/Wire.java), [Message](linux/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/linux/dbus/Message.java): Linux
- [MacNowPlaying](macos/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/macos/MacNowPlaying.java): macOS
- [SystemSessions](system/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/system/SystemSessions.java): picks by operating system

## Examples

- [OrpheusTest](core/src/test/java/lol/trq/orpheus/OrpheusTest.java): start, commands, push source, stop
- [EngineTest](core/src/test/java/lol/trq/orpheus/internal/EngineTest.java): selection, merging, position, lyrics and cover rules
- [LrcTest](core/src/test/java/lol/trq/orpheus/lyrics/LrcTest.java): lyric formats and timing
- [Scenarios](harness/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/harness/Scenarios.java): live use against a real session
